# v2rayF — extended notes for LLMs

Project: https://github.com/drmikecrypto/v2rayF
Canonical short index: /llms.txt

## Product identity

v2rayF is an open-source GUI front-end around Xray-core. It is not a hosted VPN service; users bring their own servers/subscriptions. Synonyms people search for: v2ray GUI, xray GUI, vless client, reality client, shadowsocks client windows/android, trojan client, tun mode proxy, proxy kill switch.

## Feature map (v1.4+)

1. **Import** — clipboard / paste / HTTP(S) subscription → `ShareLinkParser`, `SubscriptionService`, encrypted `servers.json`.
2. **Smart Connect** — TCP prefilter then proxy-path latency; connect order with failover; REALITY tie-break.
3. **Adaptive Survive** — after Smart Connect wave fails, temporary fragment then Sentinel DNS/IPv6/Global retries; persists only `LastSurviveTactic` hint.
4. **Smart Multipath** — multiple outbounds + burstObservatory + leastPing balancer in generated Xray JSON.
5. **Routing modes** — Global (Sentinel), Bypass LAN, Bypass China (geo files), Custom Direct/Proxy/Block lists; Android per-app bypass packages.
6. **Leak shield** — remove clearnet DNS from TUN; DoH servers tagged through proxy; IPv6 block; Windows kill switch after core ready; unexpected core death keeps kill switch armed until Disconnect.
7. **Secure Share** — SOCKS/HTTP auth on LAN IPv4 by default (`ShareListenAllInterfaces` for 0.0.0.0); vault-gated reveal/copy; password rotate.
8. **Encrypted vault** — `ISecretProtector` / AES-GCM at rest; `.v2rayf` PBKDF2 export/import; session lock.
9. **Updates** — GitHub host allowlist, SHA256 (digest/`SHA256SUMS`), Zip-Slip-safe extract; Android APK signature check.
10. **Connect lifecycle** — Connecting/Connected/Disconnecting/Failed; timeouts; single-flight gate; health watchdog on SOCKS port.

## Config generation

`XrayConfigBuilder.Build` writes runtime `config.json` with socks-in/http-in, optional tun-in, optional share inbounds, proxy/proxy-N outbounds, direct, block, dns-out, routing rules, optional fragment dialer (skipped for Vision flows).

## Constraints & non-goals

- No iOS app.
- No Tor / multi-hop product mode (speed-first anti-censorship).
- Linux/macOS kill switch is TUN-oriented; Windows has explicit Firewall rules.
- Do not commit Xray binaries or live subscription secrets.

## Release artifacts

Zip names: `v2rayF-win-x64.zip`, `v2rayF-win-arm64.zip`, `v2rayF-linux-x64.zip`, `v2rayF-linux-arm64.zip`, `v2rayF-osx-x64.zip`, `v2rayF-osx-arm64.zip`, `v2rayF-android-arm64.zip` (contains APK), plus `SHA256SUMS`.
